title: Beyond Our Sight (Documentary)
quote: I've been in the light and experienced all knowledge

title: Renaissance (Documentary)
quote: I knew everything. I knew I wasn't going to be able to keep it, but everything came to light. Everything that had been shadowed was now revealed.

title: Renaissance (Documentary)
quote: I got to feel and understand the cosmos. I got to feel and understand what all of this means. Why we're here, why there's time, why there's struggle. I learned it all.

experiencer: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
title: The near death experience of Penny Wittbrodt
quote: And as it would go through, as the light would touch every little neuron in my brain, I would know things. I would know everything about the world, every question I'd ever had, every question anybody had ever had.

title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
quote: I was shown the past, not just my past, but the past of everyone and everything, and I just had this knowing. I knew and understood why everything happened. I understood that going forward in the future there is a higher purpose and there is a reason for everything, good and bad.

title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala
quote: You could actually feel and know everything happening with everybody.

title: The near death experience of Ray Kinman
quote: And I experienced what I could only call a download. It was like billions of questions were answered in just a moment, instantly, and I understood. I understood everything—how the universe works, what our purpose is, all—everything made perfect sense to me. And it was not like I learned anything. It was more like remembering. I already knew it.

experiencer: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
title: The near death experience of Rob Gentile
quote: If I wanted to know the answer to anything, all I had to do was think about it, and it was kind of like it was felt and then absorbed. And with each Insight revealed, I thought, wow, this is how it works. Of course, it's really, really simple. And it was like these mathematical equations were just hanging all around me, and I thought the universe, the way it works, it's so elegant and simple. It's only humans that have made it so difficult to understand. And I knew everything in that place.
phrase: I knew everything in that place

experiencer: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
title: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
quote: The white light has the answers to all of our questions. Questions that we didn't even know that we had. Once I got into that white light, a lot of the questions that I had didn't even seem to matter anymore. But the answers were still there. Everything just made sense.
phrase: The white light has the answers

experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
title: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
quote: And I realized as I was asking with my words that as soon as I asked with my words then the answer would come into my awareness immediately. And so as I asked the questions faster and faster and faster, soon I realized that we were communicating telepathically without words and all I had to do was think it.
phrase: the answer would come into my awareness immediately

experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
title: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
quote: And so as I asked these questions, I just got this download and I had all this light coming into me. Like they're little darts of light, different colors shooting into my into my body, into my mind, into my heart. And each piece of light, it was information, it was knowing, it was understanding.
phrase: it was information, it was knowing, it was understanding
